title: [BUG] fvm flutter / fvm dart add ~4s per invocation (git fsck --connectivity-only on cache.git)
notes: Closed as completed by PR #1066, shipped in FVM 4.1.5. RunConfiguredFlutterWorkflow now calls EnsureCacheWorkflow with maintainGitCacheOnHit: false, so fvm flutter / fvm dart skip ensureBareCacheIfPresent (and therefore git fsck --connectivity-only) when the SDK is already installed. Cache misses, installs, and migrations still prepare the git cache. Released on origin/main as part of v4.1.5 / v4.2.0.
